FR-A1: not built: intake (kernel/intake.py, load_source) reads an idea, a markdown file or a Solution Factory folder's spec.md and plan.md as free text, with no manifest of file hashes, roles or exact record counts and no count check; it would take a manifest schema, a validator that rejects a package whose declared count differs from what is found with the file, line, expected and got values before anything is written downstream, and a structured import of the package's requirements, glossary, roles, process, screens, decisions and open questions into the canon.
FR-A2: partly built: a vague idea is classified by rule (its kind of source, and a work profile from kernel/profiles.py propose_profile), turned into guided panel questions with options (kernel/intake.py intake), answered by a named person (kernel/canon.py Canon.answer) and compiled into a contract whose requirements name who confirmed them and when (kernel/spec.py normalize, kernel/compile.py to_contract); an empty request is refused with its reason. not built: refusing a brief too ambiguous to classify, with reasons: propose_profile falls back to the default web_service profile with the basis 'no keyword stood out: the default' and intake goes on to ask the panel; it would take an ambiguity measure (for example no profile keyword and no panel reading that names a user, an outcome or a scope) and a refusal that lists what is missing before any question is asked.
